subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: Should low-continuity Skill Workshop updates override the default automatic approval policy, and if so must the shared apply service require an explicit approval grant before writing?
rationale: The change intentionally narrows the automatic-approval behavior introduced by a recent member-authored PR; code review can identify the unsafe enforcement shape but cannot decide the permanent operator workflow contract.

options.title: Gate low-continuity writes
options.body: Require an explicit approval grant at the shared write boundary for low-continuity replacements while retaining automatic application for substantially continuous updates.

options.title: Preserve unconditional auto approval
options.body: Reject structurally invalid proposals but allow every structurally valid update to apply automatically regardless of continuity.

options.title: Gate every update
options.body: Require explicit approval for all update proposals, accepting a broader workflow regression in exchange for a simpler safety rule.

recommendation.title: Gate low-continuity writes
recommendation.body: Require an explicit approval grant at the shared write boundary for low-continuity replacements while retaining automatic application for substantially continuous updates.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the automatic-approval contract that the PR would conditionally override.
